runs.text: . The authors state that EG-based separation does not remove PVDF binder from the cathode particles, and they explain this with the Hansen solubility parameter (Ra) distance: EG has a high Ra value, so PVDF dissolution in EG is weak. Delamination instead proceeds through competitive inhibition of the PVDF-current collector bonding by hydrogen bonding, not by dissolving the binder.

The authors state that EG-based separation does not remove PVDF binder from the cathode particles, and they explain this with the Hansen solubility parameter (Ra) distance: EG has a high Ra value, so PVDF dissolution in EG is weak. Delamination instead proceeds through competitive inhibition of the PVDF-current collector bonding by hydrogen bonding, not by dissolving the binder.[3]
